issues.where: the pahoehoe lava crust across the lower right and center foreground (also visible in set-A-06.png)
issues.what: the ropy crust reads as smooth, clay-like procedural zebra stripes with uniform parallel ridges and no crisp basalt fractures, grit, or glassy surface variation
issues.fix: replace the smooth sinusoidal wave pattern with multi-scale fractured basalt displacement, sharp glassy cooling cracks, and varied roughness so it reads as solid volcanic rock rather than sculpted clay

issues.where: the molten lava channel running through the foreground (also visible in set-A-06.png left crop)
issues.what: the lava fluid is a flat, smooth orange-to-yellow gradient with razor-sharp edges, no cooling crust plates or surface viscosity, and hard-clipped highlights with no bloom
issues.fix: add floating dark crust slabs, viscous flow streaks, temperature-driven surface roughness, softer incandescent edges where lava chills against rock, and optical bloom on the hottest cores

issues.where: the rock walls bordering the foreground lava channel in both left and right crops
issues.what: angular low-poly mesh facets and vertically stretched rock textures are clearly visible along the channel banks at native size
issues.fix: increase geometry subdivision and use triplanar or high-resolution rock displacement along steep channel walls to eliminate faceting and UV stretching

issues.where: the glowing lava crack at the bottom-left and the foreground lava mound in the left crop
issues.what: the glowing fissure forms an unnatural geometric 90-degree hook artifact, and the surrounding rock mound has a soft, smeared, low-resolution fibrous texture
issues.fix: fix the shader mask or UV seam causing the right-angle emissive line and increase displacement and texture resolution on the close foreground mound

issues.where: the ground beside the creature's foot and the foreground crust in the right crop
issues.what: a flat, smooth grey polygonal patch with stair-stepped edges sits immediately next to the foot, while the foreground crust is heavily stretched horizontally into blurry streaks
issues.fix: blend the foot contact terrain with higher-resolution displaced basalt geometry to remove the flat polygonal patch and eliminate horizontal texture stretching

issues.where: the close-up basalt ridge and sulfur patches in the bottom-right crop (x 0 to 17%, y 58 to 75%)
issues.what: the rock texture is heavily stretched and soft where the camera is close, and the yellow sulfur deposits look painted onto smooth clay-like lumps
issues.fix: use higher-resolution micro-displacement and triplanar texturing on the foreground ridge, and model sulfur as crusty crystalline deposits sitting in rock crevices

issues.where: the lava plain, active vents on the right, and the thin foreground fissure (also visible in set-A-03.png right crop)
issues.what: the plain reads as a smooth grey plane with repeated ripple stamps, the foreground fissure lights almost none of the adjacent rock, and the right-side vents have soft airbrushed halos with sharp streak-like spatter
issues.fix: break up the plain with varied basalt rubble and non-repeating relief, add realistic local bounce light from every glowing crack onto nearby rock edges, and give molten spatter proper incandescent trails and motion blur

issues.where: the red vapour and mesa silhouette on the far right (also visible in set-A-02.png bottom-left crop)
issues.what: the glowing haze reads as a flat uniform orange-pink tint with no volumetric structure, and the mesa edge cuts across it as a smooth, hard-edged flat-grey silhouette
issues.fix: replace the flat colour wash with lit volumetric smoke that scatters light unevenly and softens the mesa silhouette with realistic depth haze and ridge detail

issues.where: the stilt creatures standing across the lava plain
issues.what: their feet meet the flat crust with almost no grounded contact shadows or surface interaction, making them look pasted onto the ground
issues.fix: add grounded ambient occlusion and directional contact shadows under each foot along with subtle crust disturbance, dust, or heat-lit rim reflections from the lava

issues.where: the lava plain crust in the bottom-right crop (x 0 to 17%, y 58 to 75%)
issues.what: at native size the ground reads as a smooth displaced mesh with soft, stretched procedural noise and no sharp rocky micro-detail
issues.fix: add higher-frequency basalt normal and roughness detail so the mid-foreground crust holds up cleanly at native 4K resolution
